maddeler.e:
أستهجن (form X)
# أَسْتَهْجِنُ (ʔastahjinu) /ʔas.tah.d͡ʒi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# أُسْتَهْجَنُ (ʔustahjanu) /ʔus.tah.d͡ʒa.nu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# أَسْتَهْجِنَ (ʔastahjina) /ʔas.tah.d͡ʒi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# أُسْتَهْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
